intro.text: A hunter known only from one of Wayne's stories, which may not be true.

items.text: Chip planned to guide Elendel folk on hunting trips to the Roughs to see exotic beasts like lions, and borrowed money from his girlfriend to print advertising broadsheets. After they quarreled over the money she stabbed him. Constables found him bleeding in the street, told him lions were protected, jailed him, and accidentally broke his fingers in the cell door, so they healed stiff.
Wayne told Marasi he thinks of Chip whenever he feels low, to cheer himself up about his own life.
